commit.message:
feat: event prospectus redirect (#680)

* feat: prospectus route

* fix: suppress TS unused variable error in prospectus redirect

Use @ts-expect-error to suppress false positive ts(6133) in Astro
frontmatter where variables used in Astro.redirect are not recognized
as read.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: use SSR for prospectus redirect to avoid client-side flash

Switch from getStaticPaths (SSG) to prerender=false (SSR) so that
Astro.redirect produces a real HTTP 302 instead of a meta refresh.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: feedbacks

* Update astro.config.mjs

Co-authored-by: coderabbitai[bot] <136622811+coderabbitai[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix: feedbacks

- Fix typo propsectus → prospectus in sitemap filter
- Add /events/*/prospectus to robots.txt disallow

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
